reason: 该插件的主要面向用途是界面美化：通过设置面板设置本地图片路径并应用为界面壁纸，同时调整主题 token 实现半透明效果；证据来自 README 的功能说明与架构图，以及 package.json 指明的 web 客户端注入与主题/设置相关能力，未表现为数据处理、外部服务集成或自动化执行类功能。

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH 界面外观定制的插件，可通过设置面板加载本地图片作为背景，并应用半透明主题样式，同时支持恢复默认与重启保持设置。
summaries.en: This is a DSH UI customization plugin that lets users set a local image as the background, apply a translucent theme style, and reset to default while retaining the selected setting across restarts.

capabilities: Local background image loading from user-provided path
Serving image bytes from a host HTTP route for client rendering
Injecting UI theme token overrides for translucent surfaces
Registering a settings panel entry for wallpaper configuration
Persisting wallpaper path in browser storage

reasons.code: README describes a host route '/dsh-web-skin/bg' that reads local image bytes and the client fetches it as a blob for the HTML background.
README states settings.section registers a 背景图 panel and theme.overrideTokens is used to make surfaces translucent.
README and package.json show this is a DSH web plugin with a client bundle (lib/client.js) and web platform target.
